proof_body:
by
  refine ⟨continuous_pow 2, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := h 1 one_pos
  have h₁ : dist (1 / δ + δ / 2) (1 / δ) < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h₂ : 1 / δ + δ / 2 - 1 / δ = δ / 2 := by ring
    rw [h₂, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have h₃ := hd h₁
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h₃
  have h₄ : (1 / δ + δ / 2) ^ 2 - (1 / δ) ^ 2 = 1 + δ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h₄, abs_of_pos (by positivity)] at h₃
  have h₅ : 0 < δ ^ 2 / 4 := by positivity
  linarith
target_source: Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) ∧ ¬ UniformContinuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
